content.title: Goals and Highlights for Santos 2-0 Remo in Brazilian Championship Match
content.text: EVENT ENDEDWith one goal in each half, Santos beat Remo at home and added three more points to move out of the relegation zone.By Victor CunhaPublished April 2, 2026 – Updated April 2, 2026, 7:04 pm EDTADVERTISEMENTDiscover moresportSportsSoccerAnd that's all for now! Thank you so much for watching this Brasileirão match, with all the action and excitement in real time here on VAVEL! Stay tuned for updates and upcoming games. Good night and see you next time! Santos managed to dominate the match, controlling the action, taking the lead in the first half with a goal from Thaciano, while Moisés extended the lead in the second half to seal a 2-0 victory over Remo! Remo made a substitution, bringing on Jaderson for Mayk. Shortly after, Santos made two changes, bringing on João Schmidt and Robinho Júnior for Oliva and Rony. Just before that, Neymar and Diego Hernández received yellow cards. Discover moresportsSportssportSoccerNeymar found the pass on the left for Escobar to break into the box, crossing low to Moisés, who shot powerfully, sending the ball into the right corner of the net, extending Santos' lead after a VAR review, due to an offside call on the field! Yago Pikachu took a powerful shot from distance, but Brazão palmed the ball away once again, saving Santos. Shortly after, Remo made two substitutions, with Alef Manga and Gabriel Taliari leaving and Gabriel Poveda and Diego Hernández entering. Yago Pikachu received the pass and found Marcelino up front, who shot hard, but Brazão parried the ball away. Alef Manga then shot low, sending the ball into the middle of the goal, into Brazão's hands, without giving up a rebound. Rony committed a hard foul on David Braga in midfield and received a yellow card. Shortly after, Gabriel Taliari received a cross from Mayk, heading powerfully but over the goal. Santos then made two substitutions, with Thaciano and Gustavo Henrique leaving the field and Bontempo and Willian Arão entering. Discover moresportsSportssportThe game was paused for the moment while Alef Manga received treatment for pain, but he has since returned to the game. Shortly after, Remo made a substitution, with Jajá leaving and Yago Pikachu entering, another change for Remo in the match. Gustavo Henrique received a yellow card for a hard foul on Jajá. Shortly after, Santos made a substitution, with Barreal leaving and Moisés entering. Soon after coming on, Moisés received a pass and shot hard, but it went straight into Marcelo Rangel's hands. Leonel Picco received the pass up front and managed a strong shot, but it went wide. Shortly after, Zé Welison received a yellow card for a foul on Neymar, who took the free kick, sending the ball over the goal and wide. Confirming that, at the end of the first half, Thaciano received a yellow card for a foul. At halftime, Remo made a substitution, with Zé Ricardo leaving and David Braga entering. The second half started more slowly, with Santos maintaining possession. The players are back on the field and the second half of the match between Santos and Remo is underway, with all the action and excitement in real time here on VAVEL, in this match of the ninth round of the Brasileirão! Remo started the match creating dangerous chances, while Santos began to pressure and dominate the game, eventually taking the lead with Thaciano opening the scoring for Santos, who went into halftime leading Remo in this Brasileirão match! Discover moreSoccersportsSportssportAfter the goal, Santos continued to apply high pressure, dominating the game and looking for opportunities to attack, but without managing to create scoring chances, winning a corner kick that was taken into the box but cleared away by the defense. And we will have three more minutes of added time. Neymar received the pass at the edge of the box, where he managed to lob the ball over the defense for Thaciano to control and shoot low into the right corner, sending the ball into the back of the net and opening the scoring for Santos at home! The game was paused for Gabriel Taliari to receive medical attention after being fouled. Santos continues to apply high pressure, creating dangerous corner kicks, but all were cleared away by the defense. The game is becoming increasingly slow, with little happening. Both teams are creating few chances, with Santos exchanging passes, controlling the pace, and posing little threat, while Remo is unable to launch counter-attacks in the final minutes. The game was paused for Zé Welison to receive medical attention after suffering a foul, but he has already returned to the field. The pace of the game has slowed slightly at the moment, with Santos maintaining possession and Remo no longer creating attacking opportunities. Barreal found the pass up front for Gustavo Henrique, who took a powerful long-range shot, sending the ball wide once again. Santos began to try and balance the game in the final minutes, but only managed one shot so far. Mayk delivered a cross into the box and Gabriel Taliari got a powerful shot off, but sent the ball wide. Despite Santos having possession and control, Remo is the team that manages to create scoring opportunities in the attacking third. Marcelinho received the cross in the box, controlled it, and set it up for Gabriel Taliari to shoot from inside the area, but sent the ball straight to the middle of the goal, into the hands of Gabriel Brazão. Shortly after, Remo won two corner kicks in quick succession, both cleared by the defense. Zé Welison, on the corner kick, shot from distance and sent the ball wide. Following that, Jajá Silva received a yellow card for a foul on Neymar. Shortly after, Zé Ricardo received a yellow card for a hard foul on Neymar. The players are taking to the field and the ball is rolling for Santos vs. Remo, in these first 45 minutes of the match in the ninth round of the Brazilian Championship, with all the plays and emotions in real time here on VAVEL! Finally, in these seven matches, Santos also dominates in terms of goals, having scored 15 goals, averaging 2.14 goals per game. Remo, on the other hand, has only scored three goals in its history, averaging 0.43 goals per game, in a match that promises goals, at least from Santos. At home, Santos has hosted Remo in only one match, with one home win in the Brasileirão. Remo, on the other hand, has hosted Santos in six matches, with five wins and one draw in the history of the rivalry. There have been seven matches in history between the two teams, where Santos completely dominates the record, with six wins and only one draw. In the Brasileirão, as will be the case today, six matches have taken place, with five wins and one draw. Today the round continues with another match, where Chapecoense faces Atlético-MG, closing out this 6 PM slot. Then, at 8:30 PM, Palmeiras hosts Grêmio and Bragantino takes on Flamengo, thus concluding the ninth round. Yesterday, four more games took place, where Bahia beat Athletico-PR 3-0, Cruzeiro won against Vitória by the same score, while Coritiba drew 1-1 with Vasco and Fluminense beat Corinthians 3-1 in the score. After the last FIFA international break before the World Cup, we're back to work on the Brasileirão! Yesterday the round started with Botafogo beating Mirassol 3-2 at home and Internacional drawing 1-1 with São Paulo. For tonight's game, Léo Condé will have the following players available to use during the match against Santos: Ivan Quaresma, Ygor Vinhas, Matheus Alexandre, Léo Andrade, Pavani, Jaderson, Tassano, Yago Pikachu, David Braga, Hernández, Poveda and Kayky Almeida. With a 4-4-2 formation, Remo's starting lineup for tonight's Brasileirão match against Santos is: Marcelo Rangel, Marcelinho, Marllon, Zé Welison and Tchamba; Zé Ricardo, Leonel Picco, Mayk and Marcelinho; Gabriel Taliari and Jajá. For tonight's game, Cuca will have the following players to use during the match against Remo: Diógenes, Adonis Frías, Zé Ivaldo, João Schmidt, Zé Rafael, Tomás Rincón, Willian Arão, Gabriel Bontempo, Rollheiser, Moisés, Robinho Jr and Lautaro Díaz. With a 4-3-3 formation, Santos is lined up for tonight's Brasileirão match and will take the field against Remo with: Gabriel Brazão, Igor Vinícius, Lucas Veríssimo, Luan Peres and Escobar; Oliva, Gustavo Henrique and Neymar; Rony, Barreal and Thaciano. We are now starting the live broadcast of Santos vs. Remo, with all the action and excitement in real time from the ninth round of the Brazilian Championship, with the ball rolling shortly at Vila Belmiro, in this clash between teams in the relegation zone of the table! Do not miss a detail of the match with the live updates and commentaries of VAVEL. Follow along with us all the details, commentaries, analysis and lineups for this Santos vs Remo match here at VAVEL US. "I'll start from the end. Wow, I saw the images from the filming angles on the big screen and started celebrating right away. Besides the sideline, there are other angles of vision. I don't understand why that goal was disallowed. At the moment he shoots, he can't, in any way, be offside. He was, at most, on the same line. And the play would have been absolutely perfect. It was a difficult and complicated match, in which both teams are at the bottom of the table. We can't afford to make the slightest mistake. Cruzeiro had two great chances, and they unjustly denied us a goal. VAR nullified the good performance of referee Ramon. The video is already in the players' discussion group. That's in the past. We would have won an important match. What to do? Life goes on. VAR made a mistake. We will try to improve, help those who didn't play to progress and come back stronger." Sávio Pereira Sampaio will officiate today's match, with Leila Naiara Moreira da Cruz and Daniel Henrique da Silva Andrade as assistant referees, with the on-field trio coming from the Federal District. Finally, the VAR will be handled by Heber Roberto Lopes, from Santa Catarina, completing the refereeing team. On the other side, Remo has no absences for today's game, going with full strength, with the following starting 11: Marcelo Rangel, Marcelinho, Marllon, Tchamba and Kayky Almeida; Zé Ricardo, Patrick, Yago Pikachu and Vitor Bueno; Gabriel Taliari and Alef Manga. For today's game, Santos will be without Gabigol, who is injured, as well as Mayke, who is ill and out of the match, taking the field with: Gabriel Brazão, Igor Vinícius, Lucas Veríssimo, Luan Peres and Escobar; Oliva, Gustavo Henrique and Neymar; Rony, Thaciano and Moisés. Both teams are in the relegation zone, with Remo at the bottom of the table with six points, tied with Mirassol. Just above them, with seven points each, are Cruzeiro and Santos, the first team within the relegation zone, and Chapecoense, the first outside the relegation zone. One point above are Atlético-MG and RB Bragantino, two points below Botafogo and Inter, and three points behind Vitória and Corinthians. Remo, in turn, comes with a win, a loss and a draw in the last games. On Sunday (22), by 4-1, the victory came at home against Bahia, with goals from Vitor Bueno, Gabriel Taliari (2) and Jájá Silva, while Everaldo scored for Bahia. On Thursday (26), by 2-1, the defeat came to Porto Velho, away from home in the Copa Verde. And on Sunday (29), again in the Copa Verde, the draw was at home with Monte Roraima, 1-1. Santos comes into today's game with two draws and one win in the last games. On Sunday (15), in a 1-1 draw, the draw was at home against Corinthians, with Memphis Depay opening the scoring and Gabigol equalizing. On Wednesday (18), by 2-1, the defeat came at home against Inter, with goals from Zé Ivaldo, own goal, and Carbonero, while Neymar scored for Inter. And on Sunday (22), without goals, the draw was away from home against Cruzeiro. Santos vs Remo live face off this Wednesday (2), at Vila Belmiro, at 6pm ET, for the Brasileirão. The match is valid for the ninth round of the competition, with all the plays and emotions in real time here on VAVEL.
